# AutoPlanet Corporation — Full Context for LLMs

## Identity
AutoPlanet Corporation (APC) is an AI-native engineering team founded in 2024. We ship production-ready AI systems for enterprise clients. We are NOT a consultancy or agency that adopted AI — we were born from AI as a company. Our core belief: "Every business process that involves reading, writing, deciding, or routing can be automated with AI."

## What We Do
We design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems including:
- **Autonomous AI Agents** — replace L1/L2 customer support, run outreach, enrich CRMs, operate internal HR/finance/ops workflows. 24/7 operation, 42ms avg latency.
- **Custom LLM Development** — fine-tuned models on proprietary client data, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, prompt architecture engineering, domain-specific model training.
- **AI SaaS Products** — end-to-end builds from architecture to production-deployed SaaS with AI backend, UI/UX, auth, and Stripe billing.
- **Workflow Automation** — intelligent data pipelines and automated business logic replacing multi-step manual processes.
- **AI Integrations** — plug AI into existing stacks (CRM, ERP, Slack, databases) as intelligent middleware.
- **Mobile Apps** — AI-powered iOS and Android via React Native and Flutter.
- **UI/UX Design** — human-centered design for AI products.
- **Cloud & DevOps** — scalable infrastructure and CI/CD for AI workloads.
- **Performance Optimization** — Core Web Vitals, load testing, sub-second responses.
- **Enterprise Security** — red-teaming, prompt-injection defense, private model deployment in client VPC, total data sovereignty.
- **AI Strategy Consulting** — business process audit, opportunity mapping, prioritized roadmaps.
- **Machine Learning Solutions** — predictive analytics, MLOps.
- **Computer Vision** — image/video analysis, quality control, security.
- **Predictive Analytics** — trend forecasting, decision-grade dashboards.

## Engagement Model
**Fixed-price only.** Never hourly, never surprise invoices.
- **Quick Build** — ₹29,000, ~2 weeks. Single-agent deployment, core API, 30-day monitoring.
- **Full Product** — ₹89,000, 4-8 weeks. Full AI SaaS with architecture, UI/UX, backend, auth, Stripe, 90-day maintenance. (Most chosen)
- **Ongoing Partner** — ₹45,000/month. Dedicated lead engineer, weekly sprints, infinite iterations, priority R&D.

### Guarantees (in writing)
- If we can't scope within 48 hours of first call → next sprint is free
- If we miss a deadline by more than 3 days → next sprint is free
- Everything included: architecture, design, dev, testing, deploy, docs, support

## Process (4 Steps)
1. **Discovery call** (30 min, free, no sales pitch) — problem deep-dive, technical assessment, feasibility, timeline.
2. **Scope & Proposal** (within 48 hours) — architecture blueprint, feature breakdown, fixed-price quote, milestones.
3. **Build Sprint** (1-2 week cycles) — live demos every Friday, daily async updates, direct engineer access.
4. **Deploy & Hand-off** — production deployment, full documentation, source code transfer, 30-90 day support.

## Tech Stack
**Frontier Models:** GPT-4o (OpenAI), Claude 3.5 (Anthropic), Gemini (Google), Llama 3 (Meta)
**Frameworks:** Next.js, React Native, Flutter
**Infrastructure:** VPC deployment, CI/CD for AI, observability
**Billing:** Stripe integration
**AI:** RAG frameworks, agentic frameworks, LangChain-style orchestration

## Core Values
1. AI-Native Engineering — intelligence at the foundation, not bolted on
2. Speed Without Compromise — production-ready in weeks, not quarters
3. Full Ownership — 100% source code, models, and infrastructure belong to the client
4. Enterprise-Grade Delivery — hardened security, VPC, data sovereignty as defaults
